findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite the GroupModel contract stating that it never returns null; callers can expose a null/omitted subGroupCount or fail when unboxing the result.
findings.failure_mode: Concurrent deletion no longer throws at this point, but produces an invalid GroupModel result that downstream callers are not required to handle.
findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite the GroupModel contract stating that it never returns null; callers can expose a null/omitted subGroupCount or fail when unboxing the result.
findings.root_cause: The new missing-model branch returns null from an API whose documented return value is non-null.
findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null fallback (for example 0L for a group that can no longer be resolved), or otherwise remove/skip the stale group before invoking the count method.
findings.title: Preserve the non-null subgroup-count contract when the backing group disappears
findings.trigger: A cached GroupAdapter is used to populate a group representation while another request deletes that group before this adapter first resolves modelSupplier.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 275 verbatim shows `return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`. The GroupModel.java interface at L296-300 documents `@return The number of groups beneath this group. Never returns {@code null}.` GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount calls `group.getSubGroupsCount()` and passes result to `setSubGroupCount(Long)`. Returning null violates the documented non-null contract and can cause NPE on unboxing or null subGroupCount in API responses.

pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite the GroupModel contract stating that it never returns null; callers can expose a null/omitted subGroupCount or fail when unboxing the result.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Concurrent deletion no longer throws at this point, but produces an invalid GroupModel result that downstream callers are not required to handle.
raw_findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite the GroupModel contract stating that it never returns null; callers can expose a null/omitted subGroupCount or fail when unboxing the result.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new missing-model branch returns null from an API whose documented return value is non-null.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null fallback (for example 0L for a group that can no longer be resolved), or otherwise remove/skip the stale group before invoking the count method.
raw_findings.title: Preserve the non-null subgroup-count contract when the backing group disappears
raw_findings.trigger: A cached GroupAdapter is used to populate a group representation while another request deletes that group before this adapter first resolves modelSupplier.

raw_findings.body: The reader observes the stop flag before entering its loop, performs no GET request, and the test passes even if the concurrent-delete NPE remains reproducible.
raw_findings.failure_mode: The intended concurrent execution path is nondeterministic and may receive no coverage at all.
raw_findings.impact: The reader observes the stop flag before entering its loop, performs no GET request, and the test passes even if the concurrent-delete NPE remains reproducible.
raw_findings.root_cause: Starting a thread does not establish that its read loop has begun before the deletion loop proceeds.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Coordinate the test with a latch or server-side barrier so the reader has reached an in-flight groups request before deletion begins.
raw_findings.title: The concurrency test can pass without issuing any concurrent read
raw_findings.trigger: The test scheduler delays the newly started reader thread until the main test thread has deleted every group and set deletedAll to true.

raw_findings.body: The assertion can observe an empty list and pass even though the background reader subsequently records the failure the test is meant to detect.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Asynchronous failures race with the assertion and escape the regression test.
raw_findings.impact: The assertion can observe an empty list and pass even though the background reader subsequently records the failure the test is meant to detect.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test checks shared failure state without waiting for the producer thread to finish its in-flight operation.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep the Thread reference and join it, with a bounded timeout, after setting deletedAll and before asserting caughtExceptions.
raw_findings.title: Assert reader failures only after the reader has terminated
raw_findings.trigger: The reader has started a groups() request, deletion completes, and that in-flight request throws after the main thread sets deletedAll but before the reader adds the exception to caughtExceptions.

raw_findings.body: Execution skips the stop signal, leaving the non-daemon reader thread looping indefinitely and continuing requests during test teardown or preventing clean test-process shutdown.
raw_findings.failure_mode: A failing test leaks an unbounded background thread instead of shutting down its concurrent work.
raw_findings.impact: Execution skips the stop signal, leaving the non-daemon reader thread looping indefinitely and continuing requests during test teardown or preventing clean test-process shutdown.
raw_findings.root_cause: The reader termination signal is reached only on the normal completion path of an unguarded deletion loop.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Place deletedAll.set(true) in a finally block around the deletion loop and then join the reader before allowing the test to exit.
raw_findings.title: Always stop the reader when deletion fails
raw_findings.trigger: Any remove() call in the preceding deletion loop throws, such as from a failed admin request or the defect under test affecting deletion.
